19. Adverse Selection and Signaling

When information is asymmetric, how markets unravel — and how they save themselves: the lemons market, education signaling, and screening menus.

  • Akerlof's Lemons Market — Only the seller knows the quality. At price ppp only cars with q≤pq \le pq≤p are offered, so average quality is p/2p/2p/2 and the buyer's willingness to pay is WTP(p)=mp/2WTP(p) = mp/2WTP(p)=mp/2.
